findings.detail: The same actor has two names. The stem says 'Your extraction system ... calls a vendor lookup tool' and then switches to 'the agent' for the one that fills the vendor ID. The options and reasons also say 'the agent'. A reader may take the system and the agent as two different actors. Use one name, for example 'extraction agent', throughout.

blind_answer.reason: Every failed case had two or more vendors with the same name, and the prompt tells the agent to pick the closest match. That forces a heuristic choice when it should ask for another identifier, such as a tax ID or address (5.2-K4/S5). The errors are semantic rather than schema errors, so strict mode would not catch them. The vendor name was found, which rules out lost-in-the-middle effects, and the right tool was called, which rules out a tool-description problem.
